title: TrueRise self-service verification bundle (G39)
description: One expected observation per machine-checkable acceptance item, bound to the sealed intent contract hash. Coverage is sealed from the contract (skipping a machine item is a refusal); an inexecutable observation routes to the not-verified bucket, never silence. Runs on the user's machine without this repository.

contract_sealed_hash.description: the sealed intent contract hash this bundle verifies

observations.description: exactly one artifact_field/file_exists observation per machine item
